primary.title: Received Diwali bonus or cash from your employer? Know ₹15,000 exemption limit and when income tax applies | Explained
primary.summary: With Diwali celebrations over, salaried employees should understand how employers' festive gifts, vouchers and cash bonuses are taxed. The rules prescribe different tax treatments for these benefits, which can affect employees' taxable income and overall tax liability.

related.title: Received cash from customers and deposited it in your bank account? When can income tax authorities tax it
related.summary: An insurance agent's ₹35.09 lakh cash deposits during demonetisation were treated as unexplained income. ITAT Jaipur deleted the addition after accepting records showing the money came from policyholder premiums.
